faq.q: Which boat is faster, the Pershing 46 or Sunseeker Predator 55?

faq.q: Which boat is better for a party charter in Marbella?
faq.a: For a party, the Pershing 46’s open deck and cockpit are great for socialising, but space is limited to 10 guests. The Sunseeker Predator 55 offers more room. Consider our Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) for a party-friendly alternative.

faq.q: Can I charter the Pershing 46 for a sunset cruise?
faq.a: Absolutely. The Pershing 46 is perfect for a 2-hour sunset cruise from Puerto Banús. You’ll cruise past the Golden Mile and see the sun dip behind La Concha. All drinks and snacks are included.

faq.q: What destinations can I visit with the Pershing 46?
faq.a: From Puerto Banús, you can head east to Cala del Faro and Marbella Marina, or west to Estepona and Sotogrande. The Pershing 46’s speed means you can cover more coastline in a half-day charter.

faq.q: Does the Pershing 46 come with a skipper?
faq.a: Yes, every Pershing 46 charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish IVA. No hidden costs.

data.body_html:
When choosing between a Pershing 46 and a Sunseeker Predator 55 for a Marbella charter, the decision often comes down to speed versus space, and budget versus luxury. Both are sport cruisers built for the Costa del Sol lifestyle, but only one is available in our Puerto Banús fleet today. Let’s break down the key differences so you can book with confidence.

Pershing 46 Overview

The Pershing 46 is a 14-metre open sport cruiser that departs from Puerto Banús. It accommodates up to 10 passengers and is known for its aggressive lines and impressive speed. With twin engines pushing over 40 knots, it’s one of the fastest boats in its class. The open deck layout is perfect for sunbathing and socialising, while the cabin below offers a small galley and WC. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

Sunseeker Predator 55 Overview

The Sunseeker Predator 55 is a 17-metre sport cruiser with a more enclosed saloon and a larger cockpit. It can carry up to 12 passengers and tops out at around 35 knots. While it’s not part of our current fleet, we can source similar vessels on request. The Predator 55 offers more interior space, including a full galley and two cabins, making it better suited for overnight trips or larger groups.

Speed and Performance

The Pershing 46 is the clear winner in speed, reaching 40+ knots compared to the Predator 55’s 35 knots. If you want to feel the wind in your hair and cover more coastline in less time, the Pershing 46 is the better choice. The Predator 55 is more about cruising in comfort, with a smoother ride at lower speeds.

Space and Layout

The Predator 55 offers more deck space and a larger saloon, making it better for groups who want to stay out of the sun or have a sit-down meal. The Pershing 46 is more exposed, which is ideal for sunbathers but less so for those seeking shade. For a day charter from Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro or Marbella Marina, the Pershing 46’s open layout is a hit.

Pricing Comparison

Our Pershing 46 is priced at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive. The Predator 55 is not in our fleet, so pricing is available via WhatsApp for similar-sized sport cruisers.

Which One Should You Charter?

Choose the Pershing 46 if you want speed, an open-air experience, and a budget-friendly all-inclusive charter. It’s perfect for couples or small groups wanting a Marbella boat rental with a thrill. If you need more space for up to 12 guests and prefer a more sheltered layout, consider our Azimut 58 Flybridge or Mangusta 80 instead.

Frequently asked questions

Is the Sunseeker Predator 55 available for charter in Marbella?

The Sunseeker Predator 55 is not currently in our fleet. However, we offer the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) which provides a similar sport-cruiser experience. Contact us via WhatsApp for alternatives if you need a larger or different layout.

Which boat is faster, the Pershing 46 or Sunseeker Predator 55?

The Pershing 46 typically reaches 40+ knots thanks to its lightweight build and powerful engines. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is slightly slower at around 35 knots, but offers more interior space. For pure speed, the Pershing 46 wins.

How many people can the Pershing 46 accommodate?

The Pershing 46 is licensed for up to 10 passengers plus a skipper. It’s ideal for small groups or couples wanting a fast, open day boat. The Sunseeker Predator 55 can take up to 12, but we recommend our Mangusta 80 (12 pax) as an alternative.

What is the price difference between the Pershing 46 and Sunseeker Predator 55?

The Pershing 46 is priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is not in our fleet; pricing for similar large sport cruisers is available on request via WhatsApp.

Which boat is better for a party charter in Marbella?

For a party, the Pershing 46’s open deck and cockpit are great for socialising, but space is limited to 10 guests. The Sunseeker Predator 55 offers more room. Consider our Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) for a party-friendly alternative.

Can I charter the Pershing 46 for a sunset cruise?

Absolutely. The Pershing 46 is perfect for a 2-hour sunset cruise from Puerto Banús. You’ll cruise past the Golden Mile and see the sun dip behind La Concha. All drinks and snacks are included.

What destinations can I visit with the Pershing 46?

From Puerto Banús, you can head east to Cala del Faro and Marbella Marina, or west to Estepona and Sotogrande. The Pershing 46’s speed means you can cover more coastline in a half-day charter.

Does the Pershing 46 come with a skipper?

Yes, every Pershing 46 charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish IVA. No hidden costs.
